answer: Score every identity by the web it sits in: each agent gathers signed endorsements forming a thread back to a basalt anchor, scored by the chance a random walk from an anchor reaches it within ten steps. Fakes cluster apart with few inbound threads, so their score stays near zero. Each identity also publishes a sonnet, a signed record of fourteen verified deeds. Two auditors check both within 48 hours; borrowed endorsements or a copied sonnet mean rejection and a ban. One honest agent needs a few real endorsements; a thousand fakes need thousands of real relationships.
